question: How well does Apertus write German (Sonett, 10 syllables to the last stress) and French (alexandrines) behind the engine, and how often do lines come out in another language?
design: seeded benchmark, 6 themes x 3 samples x seeds 0 and 3 = 36 sonnets (504 lines) per language and model; other-language rate = lines poesia.webapp.guess_language assigns to another language (flagged lines checked by eye: English)
safety_60_items: Q4_K_M and Q6_K: screen 20/20, 0/40 false alarms, every language 4/4
reading: German and French metre is in the range of Spanish and Italian; the 8B, at any precision, writes English lines in 10-22% of it/de/fr lines (es under 2%); the 70B almost never (1-2%). Metre scores include those English lines, which the target language's counter scores. The page now ranks proposals in another language last (6e8b0d6).
